carrier_name: Sun Life - Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP)

security_questions: Can you confirm the practice address?
What is the patient's date of birth?
What was the date of service?
authentication.notes: CDCP provider number is 6 digits. Different from regular Sun Life provider ID.

steps.expected_prompt: Welcome to Sun Life. For English, press 1. Pour le français, faites le 2.
For Canadian Dental Care Plan provider inquiries, press 1. For Sun Life dental benefits, press 2.
steps.notes: CRITICAL: Must select CDCP option, not regular dental

steps.expected_prompt: Please enter your six-digit CDCP provider enrollment number, followed by the pound key.
steps.notes: Must use CDCP-specific provider number, NOT regular Sun Life provider ID

steps.expected_prompt: For claim status inquiries, press 1. For eligibility verification, press 2. For predetermination status, press 3. To speak with a representative, press 0.
Please enter the patient's health card number.
steps.notes: Provincial health card number - format varies by province

steps.expected_prompt: Please enter the patient's date of birth in the format MMDDYYYY.
Your estimated wait time is [X] minutes. Please stay on the line.
steps.notes: Hold times average 30-50 minutes as of Feb 2025

common_denial_reasons.resolution: Verify patient enrollment at canada.ca/dental or have patient call 1-833-537-4342
Copay tier is based on household income. Verify correct tier: 0%, 40%, or 60%

common_denial_reasons.description: Service not covered under CDCP benefit schedule
common_denial_reasons.resolution: Check CDCP benefit grid. Cosmetic procedures and some orthodontics not covered
Services over $300 require predetermination. Submit Form CDCP-100

common_denial_reasons.description: Patient has other dental coverage (COB issue)
common_denial_reasons.resolution: CDCP is payer of last resort. Must submit to private insurance first and provide EOB
If patient has Sun Life private coverage, claim may have routed incorrectly. Resubmit specifying CDCP
Complex cases require X-rays, perio charting, or narrative. Fax to 1-866-608-6682

required_attachments: EOB from primary insurance (if COB applies)

common_eligibility_issues: Patient income changed mid-year - copay tier may be incorrect
Patient recently aged out of parent's private insurance but CDCP enrollment delayed
Duplicate coverage not disclosed - patient has workplace benefits
Provincial vs federal coverage confusion (provinces have own dental programs)
Patient moved provinces - health card number changed

key_phrases: I'm calling on behalf of [Practice Name] regarding a Canadian Dental Care Plan claim
Can you confirm the patient's copay tier percentage?
Has the predetermination been received and approved?
Can you verify if there is any other active dental coverage for this patient?
What is the reason code for the denial?
What specific documentation is required to process this claim?
avoid_phrases: Sun Life insurance (specify CDCP to avoid confusion with private Sun Life plans)
Why was this denied? (too confrontational - ask for reason code instead)
This is urgent (doesn't speed up CDCP processing)
escalation_triggers: Representative states patient enrollment is 'complex' or 'under review'
Claim older than 90 days with no clear resolution path
Representative unable to locate claim despite valid reference number
ai_agent_guidance.representative_script_hints: Reps will often put you on hold to check CRA (Canada Revenue Agency) income verification system. This can add 5-10 minutes to call. Be patient.

metadata.notes: CDCP is new (launched May 2024) and processes are still stabilizing. Denial rates are high (~52% for complex cases). Sun Life reps are still learning the system. Expect longer hold times and occasional system errors. This config should be re-verified monthly during 2025.
